site.heroText: The [KMA] KissMyAzz alliance handbook for Last Asylum: Plague. Heroes, sanctuary builds, alliance events, rallies, shields, codes. Written for phones, searchable, and dated so you know what is current.
site.footer: [KMA] KissMyAzz is a player alliance in Last Asylum: Plague led by viciouslywild (R5). Numbers come from public wikis and guides (mainly wiki-last-asylum.com, lastasylumplague.com, lastasylumguide.com) checked on the date shown on each guide. The game patches weekly, so verify anything that matters in-game and tell an officer if something is wrong. Not affiliated with 37GAMES or Cloudwalker. Game artwork and screenshots are © 37GAMES and Cloudwalker, taken from the official site and wiki-last-asylum.com for alliance use.
